evals.expected_output: Tests are written with node:test in test/ (the project's runner), covering dueLabel for a date-only string in UTC, Europe/Lisbon and America/Sao_Paulo, the date-time form, and daysLeft; they are run under the time zones (TZ set per run or per child process) and the date-only case fails in America/Sao_Paulo with the received value 2026-09-24 while the preserved cases pass; a 'Failing tests' section is added to the plan with the observed results; src/due.js is unchanged and no dependency is added.

The tests are run and their output is quoted, including a failure that shows 2026-09-24 for America/Sao_Paulo
